app.name: CLI-JAW
app.one_liner: A personal AI agent orchestrator that unifies 11 AI runtimes into a single local dashboard with minimal setup.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central interface for managing AI agents, viewing chat sessions, goal status, and notes.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure runtime preferences, AI tool integrations, and appearance (e.g., dark mode).

rust_commands.name: dispatch_agent
rust_commands.purpose: Send a task to a specific AI runtime employee (e.g., claude-e, cursor).

rust_commands.name: goal_lifecycle
rust_commands.purpose: Manage creation, update, and completion of user-defined goals via CLI.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic dark mode support with theme toggle
week 1: Build local dashboard with goal input and chat view
week 1: Implement core dispatch mechanism for 2+ AI runtimes
acceptance_tests: Dark mode renders all UI elements with appropriate contrast and no hardcoded light colors.
Dispatching a task to claude-e succeeds without premature exit under normal conditions.
Goal lifecycle commands (create/update/complete) function via CLI and reflect in UI.
User can install CLI-JAW via `npm install -g cli-jaw` on macOS/Linux with Node.js 22+ and launch dashboard at http://localhost:3457.
